scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n app,sidecar -c blue,green "pnpm --filter app dev" "pnpm dev:sidecar"
scripts.dev:sidecar: cd sidecar && TRANSCRIBE_DUMP=1 uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n app,sidecar -c blue,green "pnpm --filter app start" "pnpm start:sidecar"
scripts.start:sidecar: cd sidecar && TRANSCRIBE_DUMP=1 TRANSCRIBE_DUMP_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/learn-polish/clips" uv run uvicorn main:app --port 10001
